newsitem.title: GREECE: Bulgarian President Stoyanov visits Greece.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian President Stoyanov visits Greece.

text.p: Bulgarian President Petar Stoyanov on Wednesday began a three-day official visit to Greece, the first such high level visit by a Bulgarian official since 1989.
Stoyanov met Greek President Costis Stephanopoulos and was scheduled to meet later in the day Prime Minister Costas Simitis and other senior Greek officials.
He will sign an agreement for the construction of the new bridge linking the two countries next to an old one at the northern Promahonas border post. Greece will finance the entire project
Stephanopoulos said Greece backed Bulgaria's efforts to become a European Union and NATO member.
